description: Send a photo or PDF of a UK parking ticket or other penalty notice (parking, bus lane, road charges, rail, tram and bus penalty fares, tolls, and other penalties with a written way to challenge them; a police ticket such as speeding, a red light, a phone or insurance is written as a letter the driver sends themselves). ByeFine reads it and says, free, whether it is worth challenging and why. It does not handle court papers. Give either file_url (https) or file_base64 with mime.

file_url.description: An https address of the photo or PDF.
